banner.note: Nothing here is real: no payment, no messages, and everything you change stays in this browser.
banner.resetBody: The products, stock, orders and categories go back to their starting state, the cart is emptied and you are signed out.

search.placeholder: Search mixers, pipes, sinks… (Arabic or English)
search.title: Search
search.emptyHint: Try another word, a code such as NIL-MIRA-B, or browse the categories.
search.tolerant: The search reads Arabic letter variants as the same letter (أ / ا / إ, ة / ه, ى / ي) and knows a few synonyms (mixer = tap = خلاط).

home.heroTitle: Everything for the bathroom and the kitchen — from the first pipe to the last towel bar
home.heroText: A working demo of the shop's system: browse the catalogue, pick a finish, check out (simulated), then open the back office and run the shop.
home.bundles: Complete sets — cheaper than the parts

scenarios.search: Search in Arabic with letter variants
scenarios.variant: Pick a finish and see the price and stock change
scenarios.checkout: Check out (simulated) and follow the order
scenarios.bulkMove: As the owner: move products between categories, with a preview
scenarios.stock: Record a stock movement between warehouses
scenarios.cashier: As the cashier: move an order to its next status

category.allText: From rough-in (pipes, fittings, valves) to finishing (mixers, showers, ceramics, sinks, accessories).

product.vatNote: Prices exclude 14% VAT, which is added at checkout.
product.illustration: Illustration drawn for the demo — not a product photo

cart.title: Your cart
cart.couponHint: Try the demo coupon DEMO10 (10% off before VAT).

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.simulationNote: No card is asked for and no money moves. Placing the order only changes this browser's demo data.
checkout.name: Full name
checkout.emptyCart: Your cart is empty — add something first.
checkout.guest: Ordering as a guest — sign in as customer@demo to see the order under «My orders».

order.title: Order {number}
order.placed: Thank you — your demo order is placed.
order.simulateHint: In the real shop the team moves the order. Here you can play their part.
order.finished: This order has reached its end.
order.cancelledNotice: This order was cancelled; its goods went back to stock.
order.returnedNotice: This order was returned; its goods went back to stock.
order.awaitingNotice: Waiting for the shop to confirm the order.

myOrders.title: My orders
myOrders.guestNote: You are not signed in: these are the orders placed as a guest in this browser.

auth.title: Demo sign-in
auth.intro: Pick a role. There are no passwords: this only chooses what you may do in this browser.
auth.demoOnly: Demo accounts — not real people, nothing is checked against a server.

roleText.owner: Everything: products, categories, stock, orders and the activity log.
roleText.cashier: Orders only — the other back-office screens are refused by the API.
roleText.customer: The shop and «My orders». No back office.

admin.title: Back office
admin.roleNote: Demo role: {role}. What you change stays in this browser.
admin.noAccess: This screen is not open to your role.
admin.noAccessHint: Sign in as owner@demo to see every screen.
admin.signInFirst: Sign in with a demo account to open the back office.

productsPage.previewIntro: Nothing has changed yet. Read the list, then confirm.

categoriesPage.intro: Products stand on final categories only. A category that holds products cannot get sub-categories until they are moved.

stockPage.intro: Stock is kept per variant and per warehouse. Sets have no stock of their own: they are counted from their parts.
stockPage.onlyLow: Only low or out of stock

ordersPage.noNext: This order has reached its end.
ordersPage.confirmCancel: Cancel order {number}? Its goods go back to the main warehouse.
ordersPage.selectHint: Choose an order to see it here.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.signInRequired: Please sign in with a demo account first.
errors.forbidden: Your demo role is not allowed to do this.
errors.lineNotFound: This line is no longer in the cart.
errors.outOfStockOrder: Some items are no longer in stock. Please check the cart.
errors.couponInvalid: This coupon is not valid. Try DEMO10.
errors.noNextStep: This order has no next step.
errors.statusNotAllowed: An order cannot go from {from} to {to}.
errors.targetMissing: Choose the category to move to.
errors.targetNotLeaf: This category has sub-categories. Products stand on final categories only — choose one of its sub-categories.
errors.productsMissing: {count} of the selected products no longer exist.
errors.nothingToMove: All selected products are already in this category.
errors.cannotApply: The move cannot be applied — preview it again.
errors.previewStale: The data changed since the preview. Please preview again.
errors.parentHasProducts: This category holds {count} products. Move them to a final category first; a category with products cannot get sub-categories.
errors.duplicateName: A category with this name already exists at that place.
errors.moveIntoItself: A category cannot be moved into itself or into one of its own sub-categories.
errors.bundleHasNoStock: A set has no stock of its own; move its parts instead.
errors.notEnoughStock: Not enough stock in that warehouse — {available} available.
errors.noChange: The counted quantity equals the current stock; nothing to correct.

footer.about: A standalone demo of the Abosefen sanitaryware shop system. Every product, brand, price, stock figure, order and person in it is invented.
footer.noNetwork: The demo runs entirely in your browser: it sends no data anywhere.
footer.builtWith: React · Vite · Tailwind CSS — no backend
